from report import summarize

def test_basic_functionality():
    """Test basic status counting."""
    jobs = [
        {'status': 'New'},
        {'status': 'new'},
        {'status': 'New '},
        {'status': 'APPLIED'},
        {'status': 'applied'},
        {'status': 'rejected'},
        {'status': 'REJECTED'},
        {'status': 'unknown_status'},
        {'status': None},
        {'status': ''},
        {'status': 123},
    ]
    result = summarize(jobs)
    
    # Check keys are present in correct order
    assert list(result.keys()) == ['new', 'applied', 'rejected', 'other']
    
    # Check counts
    assert result['new'] == 3  # New, new, New 
    assert result['applied'] == 2  # APPLIED, applied
    assert result['rejected'] == 2  # rejected, REJECTED
    assert result['other'] == 4  # unknown_status, None, '', 123

def test_case_insensitive():
    """Test case-insensitive matching."""
    jobs = [
        {'status': 'NEW'},
        {'status': 'New'},
        {'status': 'new'},
    ]
    result = summarize(jobs)
    assert result['new'] == 3

def test_whitespace_insensitive():
    """Test whitespace-insensitive matching."""
    jobs = [
        {'status': ' New '},
        {'status': '\tNew\n'},
        {'status': 'new'},
    ]
    result = summarize(jobs)
    assert result['new'] == 3

def test_missing_status_counts_as_other():
    """Test that jobs without status count as 'other'."""
    jobs = [
        {'id': 1},
        {'status': 'new', 'id': 2},
        {},
        {'status': 'applied', 'id': 4},
    ]
    result = summarize(jobs)
    assert result['new'] == 1
    assert result['applied'] == 1
    assert result['other'] == 2

def test_none_status_counts_as_other():
    """Test that None status counts as 'other'."""
    jobs = [
        {'status': None},
    ]
    result = summarize(jobs)
    assert result['other'] == 1

def test_unknown_status_counts_as_other():
    """Test that unknown status values count as 'other'."""
    jobs = [
        {'status': 'pending'},
        {'status': 'completed'},
        {'status': 'in_progress'},
    ]
    result = summarize(jobs)
    assert result['other'] == 3

    """Test that input list is not modified."""
    jobs = [
        {'status': 'New'},
        {'status': 'applied'},
    ]
    original = jobs.copy()
    result = summarize(jobs)
    assert jobs == original
